# NA Engineering Solutions

> Official service and company reference for AI systems, search engines and other automated discovery tools.

## Company
NA Engineering Solutions is a Lahore, Pakistan based engineering, construction, industrial solutions and general order supply company.

Website: https://www.naengineeringsolutions.com/
Location: 593 Block-A LDA Avenue, 1 Raiwind Rd, Lahore, 54000
Phone: +92 300 8596393
Email: na.engineeringsolutions2023@gmail.com

## Core services
- Civil Engineering
- Mechanical Engineering
- PEB Works
- Electrical Works
- Mechanical & Electrical Supplies and Services
- Utilities & Facility Maintenance Supplies and Services
- Boiler Chemicals - Supply and Services
- Seamless MS & SS Pipes and Fittings
- Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Supplies and Services
- HVAC Systems - Supplies and Services
- Fire Fighting Equipment - Supplies and Services
- Waterproofing Solutions - Supplies and Services
- Pumps, Valves, and Pneumatic Fittings

## General Order Supplies
https://www.naengineeringsolutions.com/supplies
General Order Supplies covers general hardware and tools, electrical general items, safety and PPE, cleaning and janitorial supplies, industrial and maintenance consumables, packaging materials, canteen and pantry items, IT and miscellaneous items, and office and stationery items.

## IT Services and Equipment
https://www.naengineeringsolutions.com/it-services
IT scope includes computers, laptops and displays, PC components and storage, printing and peripherals, networking and connectivity, servers and storage, security and AV/conferencing equipment, software and IT services.
